items.text: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A.
ANSWER ANY TWO QUESTIONS IN SECTION B.
State three methods used for communicable disease control.
Explain the chain of infection, and state why breaking it is important?
Explain the role of community participation in disease control programmes.
Describe five nutritional requirements during pregnancy.
Explain the significance of antenatal care in reducing maternal mortality.
Name five methods of solid waste disposal used in communities.
What is disease eradication, and how does it differ from disease elimination?
Define an epidemic and distinguish it from a pandemic.
